content: Patients who are not undergoing dialysis should restrict their dietary protein intake to approximately 0.8 grams per kilogram of body weight per day. This limitation is recommended to help slow the progression of chronic kidney disease (CKD). Consuming higher amounts of protein can lead to a more rapid decline in kidney function, especially in individuals with advanced stages of CKD. In most cases, sodium consumption is advised to be restricted to less than 2,300 milligrams per day.
